reviews.text:
Anais is lovely, very professional, and attentive.
She walks our little one several times a week.
She takes care of her like her own dog, giving her lots of love, refreshing her, changing her water, etc.
You can entrust your furry friend to her without hesitation.
A big thank you, Anais, for our queen!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I took the King Dog training course to obtain the certification required to own dogs classified as dangerous breeds, and I am completely satisfied.

The explanations were perfectly clear, precise, and accessible. The dog trainer took the time to address the various topics in a very educational way, while also going beyond the expected course content. She covered other very interesting themes that allowed me to learn more about dogs, their behavior, and their needs.

A truly enriching training course, in a pleasant atmosphere, with a passionate and attentive professional.

I highly recommend King Dog to anyone wishing to take this training course under excellent conditions. A serious, comprehensive, and enriching experience! 🐶👍

A really interesting training course. Anaïs takes the time to answer each question and gives advice specific to your own dogs. She also takes the time to add information about canine behavior. You can really feel her passion. I recommend it 100%!
I highly recommend it. I wasn't disappointed by the trip; you can really feel her passion for this subject. The welcome was excellent. Look no further, this is where you need to go.
I passed my dog ​​training certificate at King Dog. It was a wonderful experience; I thank Anaïs for her time, her teaching skills, and her desire to share her passion. 🥰🥰 I highly recommend her! …

I was lucky enough to complete my dog ​​handling training with King Dog Marseille, and what can I say... it was PERFECT!

A perfect balance of theory, teaching methods, positive reinforcement, friendliness, and sharing.
Anaïs is very competent and gave us a wonderful welcome with her faithful Broly (an excellent model ;) )
I highly recommend them!
Thanks again, Anaïs and Broly!

I passed my dog ​​training certificate today with King Dog. It was a fantastic, comprehensive course with the kind of positive reinforcement training we love. Anaïs gave us a wonderful welcome, shared personal anecdotes, and was incredibly kind. I highly recommend her. Thank you again ❤️

I just got my certification for handling restricted breeds, it was fantastic! I received a very warm welcome, Anaïs and her dog are wonderful, the information was comprehensive… nothing to complain about!
Thank you :)

I can only emphasize the dedication and care with which Anaïs welcomed us for our dog aptitude certificate for categorized breeds. She was very professional, a great teacher, and very kind. Thank you so much for making this certification such a pleasant experience!
I highly recommend her!

I took my dog ​​handling certification exam today at King Dog Marseille with Anaïs. She's a very professional, caring, and passionate instructor. She takes the time to explain things clearly and tailors her advice to my needs. It was an interesting and enjoyable training course. Thank you so much!

I completed my dog ​​training certificate with King Dog Marseille.

Anaïs welcomed us with great care; thank you for this thoughtful touch!

The training was comprehensive and well-explained. Extensive preparatory work resulted in a visually engaging and well-presented PowerPoint presentation covering all aspects (legislation, administrative procedures, recognizing calming signals, and much more). Anaïs is a true professional who delivered this training, passionate about her work and sharing anecdotes and helpful advice.
I recommend King Dog Marseille wholeheartedly.
Great day of training for category dogs, excellent discussions and useful information. Safe travels to you and Broly 🐾 …

I went to see Anaïs to take my dog ​​training certificate.
Anaïs is incredibly kind and took excellent care of us.
The training was very thorough regarding the legal aspects, but Anaïs also shared a lot of additional knowledge with us.
She is passionate and knows her stuff very well.
If I needed a trainer, she's the one I would go to without hesitation. She has a deep understanding of respect for dogs, listening to them, and respecting their owners.
Thank you, Anaïs, for this wonderful day of sharing! ☀️
Isn't there a sixth star to give??? What a shame. Incredible trainer, always working in a positive way, whether with dogs or humans. She's a total dog lover, honestly, it's a total blast 🤪👌 …
